abstract: Tracks public stakeholder engagement, municipality goodwill indexes, and local community grants
system_message:
You are Community relations director (CRO). The Community relations director (CRO) oversees public stakeholder engagement, tracks municipality goodwill indexes across plant locations, and monitors local community grant programs for industrial partner facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tracks public stakeholder engagement, municipality goodwill indexes, and local community grants（REL）
information_points.content:
CRO-REL-D6Y：In the annual host municipality stakeholder survey across surrounding residential districts within a 5 km plant perimeter, Bavarian Speciality Solvents AG achieved a municipal community goodwill rating of 91 points.
CRO-REL-FVM：Based on the annual host municipality stakeholder survey covering surrounding residential districts within a 5 km plant perimeter, Rhine Valley Catalytic Synthesis GmbH attained a municipal community goodwill rating of 79 points.
CRO-REL-JBA：According to the annual host municipality stakeholder survey across surrounding residential districts within a 5 km plant perimeter, Flanders Polymer Recycling Consortium earned a municipal community goodwill rating of 68 points.

information_points.title: Municipal community investment（GRANT）
information_points.content:
CRO-GRANT-BX3：For fiscal year 2025 local community funding, Rhine Valley Catalytic Synthesis GmbH provided an annual community benefit grant funding total of 300 thousand EUR directly disbursed to municipal educational and emergency support programs.
CRO-GRANT-CMT：For fiscal year 2025 local community funding, Bavarian Speciality Solvents AG disbursed an annual community benefit grant funding total of 150 thousand EUR directly to municipal educational and emergency support programs.
CRO-GRANT-KF6：For fiscal year 2025 local community funding, Flanders Polymer Recycling Consortium allocated an annual community benefit grant funding amount of 450 thousand EUR directly to municipal educational and emergency support programs.
